mechanism_narrative: The recent strong week-on-week rebound in RETAIL_REC mobility indicates a sustained recovery in consumer activity, which will continue to drive retail and recreation visits higher over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to the average of the last 28 days, despite the recent rebound.

mechanism_narrative: A significant week-on-week increase in PARKS mobility, exceeding 20 points, suggests improved weather or increased outdoor leisure, which will positively spill over into general retail and recreation activity within the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by more than 20 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase in the next two weeks following a >20 point rise in PARKS mobility.

mechanism_narrative: Despite a recent rebound in RETAIL_REC, the continued decline in WORKPLACES mobility combined with persistently high RESIDENTIAL mobility indicates that a significant portion of the population remains home-bound, limiting the potential for sustained retail recovery over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is significantly higher than the last 28 days, despite WORKPLACES continuing to fall and RESIDENTIAL remaining high.

mechanism_narrative: While RETAIL_REC shows a rebound, the persistently low and stagnant TRANSIT mobility, remaining below -30% from baseline, indicates that major commuting and city center activity is still severely suppressed, capping any significant retail recovery over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days shows a strong upward trend, even as TRANSIT mobility remains below -30% from baseline.

mechanism_narrative: The synchronized week-on-week rebound in both GROCERY_PHARM and RETAIL_REC mobility suggests a broader return of consumer confidence and willingness to leave home for non-essential activities, which will drive RETAIL_REC higher over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM and RETAIL_REC both rise week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase in the next two weeks despite both GROCERY_PHARM and RETAIL_REC showing a synchronized week-on-week rebound.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained and accelerating decline in WORKPLACES mobility, with the latest week showing a drop greater than 4 points, indicates a deepening trend of remote work or business closures, which will suppress RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls by more than 4 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than the last 28 days, despite WORKPLACES continuing its accelerated decline.

mechanism_narrative: The sustained high level of RESIDENTIAL mobility, consistently above 6% from baseline, indicates a continued preference for staying home, which will act as a persistent drag on RETAIL_REC recovery over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days shows a significant increase, even while RESIDENTIAL mobility remains consistently above 6%.
